name: Paradox-touched Valley Tent
title: Paradox-touched Valley Tent
summary: A single tent on a ridge (z 318) overlooking the Paradox-touched Valley, staging point for the Arcanum agents and royal guards of the Paradox-touched quests (Ethan Wintermaine, Hisham al-Evv...). The kit shows the gold-trimmed fabric tent (16 m square) flying a Strathelar pennant, with chairs and a table outside; the valley floor 80 m below (z 240) holds three dark purple stone ruins, olthoi-infested slopes and snow peaks (to z 440) rise behind. Landblocks south of y 34752 and west of x 37440 are missing from the kit.

landmarks.name: Strathelar Pennant
landmarks.note: Flag on the tent roof, top z 324.9.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch1).

shots.standingOrder: Pull back and up from 16 m to 56 m south-east of the Arcanum tent, 4 m to 24 m above it, over the drop into the Paradox-touched Valley; keep the tent centred, nothing within 15 m.
shots.notes: The lone royal-guard tent with its Strathelar pennant on the ridge (z 318) above the Paradox-touched Valley (z 240): the dronie flies out over the valley edge so the ground falls away 90 m beneath the lens while the tent shrinks on its ridge against the snow peaks. Noon light from behind-left. Kit misses the landblocks south of y 34752; the move stays north-east of them.
